input.quote: 16.2 Indemnification of Ono. Array shall indemnify and hold harmless each of Ono, its Affiliates and Sublicensees and the directors, officers and employees of Ono, its Affiliates and Sublicensees and the successors and assigns of any of the foregoing (the "Ono Indemnitees"), from and against any and all Liabilities from any Third Party Claims incurred by any Ono Indemnitee, arising from, or occurring as a result of:
input.rationale: Array does give us an indemnity (Section 16.2), but it is limited to Array's own Array Territory commercialization, Array-sponsored Clinical Studies and breach of Array's Article 15 representations. It contains no third-party intellectual property infringement indemnity, and Section 15.4 expressly disclaims any warranty of non-infringement, while Section 11.4(a) leaves each Party to defend patent Infringement Actions "at its own expense". As licensee we therefore bear all IP risk for compounds and patents that Array controls, which fails even the fallback (licensor IP indemnity with usual exclusions and remedies). Our reciprocal indemnity in 16.1 is appropriately scoped to our Ono Territory acts and studies, so no narrowing is needed there. Minimal redline adds a new Section 16.2(e) IP indemnity with customary modification/combination carve-outs, overriding the 11.4 cost allocation for such claims; procedure, allocation and consequential-damages provisions in 16.3–16.5 already work as standard.

proposal.summary: Add third-party IP infringement indemnity from Array to Ono in Section 16.2
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Array's indemnity in Section 16.2 currently omits third-party intellectual property claims, and Section 15.4 disclaims any non-infringement warranty, so we would carry all freedom-to-operate risk for the compounds Array licensed to us. We have added a licensor IP indemnity with the usual carve-outs for our own modifications or combinations; if helpful we can discuss a cap on this indemnity or an allocation consistent with Section 16.4.

ops.oldText: and (d) any breach of any representations, warranties or covenants by Array in Article 15 above, except to the extent such Third Party Claims result from the gross negligence or willful misconduct of a Ono Indemnitee.
ops.newText: and (d) any breach of any representations, warranties or covenants by Array in Article 15 above, and (e) notwithstanding Section 11.4, any Third Party Claim alleging that the Development, Manufacture, Commercialization or use of any Product, or the practice of the Array Patents or Array Know-How licensed to Ono hereunder, infringes or misappropriates any intellectual property right of a Third Party (except to the extent such Third Party Claim arises from Ono's modification of a Product or the combination of a Product with any product not supplied or approved by Array), except to the extent such Third Party Claims result from the gross negligence or willful misconduct of a Ono Indemnitee.
